title: Sauce action program
description: A sequence of protocol actions that compiles to one Sauce program executing on one chain. Amounts are base-10 strings. Beyond this schema, a program must satisfy: every address with mixed-case hex carries a valid EIP-55 checksum; every amount fits its declared width; a first action that takes an amount sets `amount`; an amountRef names a saveOutputAs set by an earlier action, and is not combined with `amount`; argument names are unique; and the value of every balanceOf/nativeBalance/argument action is read.

$schema.description: The schema this document declares; ignored.

chainId.description: The chain every action executes on.

address.description: An address: 0x + 40 hex digits. A mixed-case address must carry a valid EIP-55 checksum.

recipient.description: An address, or "self" for the executing Pot.

remoteRecipient.description: An address, or a 32-byte account on a non-EVM destination (0x + 64 hex digits).

bytes.description: 0x-prefixed hex bytes, an even number of digits.

identifier.description: A name that becomes a local variable in the emitted SauceScript.
